thread:
Dara: kicking off a focused "recurrence deep-dive" for the last 120 days. goal: capture root themes, assign clear owners, and set measurable timelines. posting a compact synthesis + proposed owners. please ack and flag conflicts.

MonitorBot: analysis complete: 34 incidents found. Clusters identified: pool-saturation, deploy-template-bugs, warmup-regressions, downstream-rate-limit, cert-rotation-failures. Summary report: https://infra.internal/recurrence-deep-dive-120d

Noel: can you give raw counts per cluster?

Dara: counts: pool-saturation 12, deploy-template-bugs 8, warmup-regressions 6, downstream-rate-limit 5, cert-rotation-failures 3.

Hana: I'll take deploy-template-bugs. observed pattern: templating edge-cases skip required tags in blue-green deploys. Plan: add stricter CI validations + a post-deploy verifier that queries runtime routing metadata. ETA: 2026-04-08.

Quinn: I'll own pool-saturation. immediate mitigation: temporary pool margin during scheduled model refreshes + alert tuning. longer term: autoscaler smoothing and better KV cache reuse. ETA for short fix: 10 days.

Noel: warmup-regressions I'll handle. implement lightweight pre-warm step that runs in parallel to container startup and a gauge-based warmup cutoff. Avoid double-alloc by locking GPU tokens during warmup. ETA: 3 weeks.

Dara: listing proposed action items I will convert to tracked tickets. please confirm owners.

Dara: ```
- ACTION-RD-01: Short-term pool margin + alert rule improvements. Owner: Quinn. ETA: 2026-04-05. Deliverables: updated policy, load-test notes, alert thresholds.
- ACTION-RD-02: Deploy template CI validators + post-deploy metadata checker. Owner: Hana. ETA: 2026-04-08. Deliverables: linter, CI gating rule, runbook for label remediations.
- ACTION-RD-03: Warmup pre-step + GPU token lock. Owner: Noel. ETA: 2026-04-20. Deliverables: warmup lib, benchmark, rollout plan.
- ACTION-RD-04: Downstream rate-limit strategy (retries + budget + circuit breaker). Owner: Dara. ETA: 2026-04-12. Deliverables: retry matrix, circuit-breaker config, product sign-off.
- ACTION-RD-05: Cert rotation audit + automation. Owner: Dara. ETA: 2026-03-31. Deliverables: rotation monitor, automated renewal job, expired-cert alert.
```

Hana: note : CI validators must include a schema test for pool, region, canary fields. I'll add test vectors.

Quinn: drafting the pool alert now. putting a suggested rule: expr: sum(node_allocated_cpu) / sum(node_capacity_cpu) > 0.92 for: 6m labels: severity=page annotations: summary="Cluster allocation >92% - risk of pool saturation"

Noel: for warmup I'll prototype a no-op warmup that touches model weights to populate caches, then measure tail latency. will post numbers mid-week.

Dara: MonitorBot will create tickets ENG-5101..ENG-5105 and add the "recurrence_reason" field (options: capacity-surge, template-bug, warmup-gap, external-flaky, ops-miss).

MonitorBot: Reminder: Any ACTION without an owner after 48h will be auto-assigned to the oncall engineer.

Hana: ack. I'll start a PR for the linter and request infra review.

Quinn: ack. I'll run a short cluster bump test tomorrow and share results here.

Noel: ack. requesting a 24h low-traffic window for final warmup integration tests; posting calendar invite.

Dara: I'll schedule a 30m review two weeks out to check progress and unblock any product sign-offs. Will paste ticket links when created. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
